# AI Energy Intelligence UK — UK AI Energy Intelligence Centre

> Free UK-focused calculators, analysis and reports on the electricity cost, infrastructure impact and business case for AI. Three expert hubs: Energy Cost, Infrastructure and Business.

## Hubs

- [Energy Cost Hub](/energy-cost): Calculators for AI electricity, AI search and model training energy and cost.
- [Infrastructure Hub](/infrastructure): Grid impact, growth zones and data centre demand for the UK.
- [Business Hub](/business): AI ROI, energy savings and readiness assessment tools.

## Energy Cost Tools

- [AI Electricity Cost Calculator](/energy-cost/ai-electricity-cost-calculator): Estimate the electricity cost of AI usage.
- [AI Search Cost Calculator](/energy-cost/ai-search-cost-calculator): Compare the energy cost of AI search vs traditional search.
- [AI Model Training Calculator](/energy-cost/ai-model-training-calculator): Estimate the energy and cost of training AI models.

## Infrastructure Tools

- [AI Grid Impact Forecast](/infrastructure/ai-grid-impact-forecast): Forecast AI's impact on UK grid demand.
- [AI Growth Zone Impact](/infrastructure/ai-growth-zone-impact): Model regional AI growth zone impact.
- [Data Centre Demand Calculator](/infrastructure/data-centre-demand-calculator): Estimate data centre electricity demand.
- [AI Data Centre Electricity Calculator](/ai-data-centre-electricity-calculator): Server load, PUE and UK cost.
- [AI Water Consumption Calculator](/ai-water-consumption-calculator): Estimate AI data centre water use.

## Business Tools

- [AI ROI Calculator](/business/ai-roi-calculator): Calculate the ROI and payback of AI investment.
- [AI Energy Savings Calculator](/business/ai-energy-savings-calculator): Model energy savings from AI.
- [AI Readiness Assessment](/business/ai-readiness-assessment): Score your organisation's AI readiness.

## Guides & Analysis

- [AI Energy Myth Checker](/ai-energy-myth-checker): Evidence-led verdicts on common AI energy myths.
- [AI Electricity Cost Guide](/guides/ai-electricity-cost-calculator): UK business guide to AI electricity cost.
- [Research](/research): Analysis and reports on AI energy and infrastructure.
